What are the requirements for Beneficial Ownership Requirements (Legal Entities) under bank policy?

Under internal policy [POL-AML-2026-V4 / Sec. 101.3], For accounts opened on behalf of legal entities (corporations, LLCs, partnerships), bank staff must identify and verify:
- Each individual who directly or indirectly owns 25% or more of the equity interests of the entity.
- One single individual with significant responsibility to control, manage, or direct the legal entity (e.g., CEO, CFO, Managing Member).
Failure to provide beneficial ownership certification requires immediate rejection of the onboarding request.

What are the requirements for SAR Filing Mandate under bank policy?

Under internal policy [POL-AML-2026-V4 / Sec. 103.1], A Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) must be filed with FinCEN no later than 30 calendar days after the date of initial detection of facts that may constitute a basis for filing. If no suspect was identified on the date of detection, the bank may delay filing for up to 60 calendar days to identify a suspect.
